subject: Audit log surcharge - portfolio discount matrix
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@medica-health.com>
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Audit log / KMS / Residency pricing request

Hi Evelyn / Ben,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Procurement asked me to get a clear, itemized price list we can show finance for the compliance add-ons: audit log retention (30 days vs 1 year vs 3 years), audit-log ingest costs (per GB), KMS vs HSM (per-seat annual vs per-request), and a HIPAA-compliant package that bundles residency + HSM + audit retention.

Two asks from our side:
- Can you show list pricing + the discounted rates you would offer for a 12-mo vs 36-mo committed deal (we're aiming for a 36-mo anchor but may prefer 12-mo pilot).
- Any ability to waive ingestion fees for the first 90 days of a pilot?

We are targeting a go-live pilot in Q3. Rough expected volume: ~25M tokens/month during pilot, growing to ~120M tokens/month in year 1 if successful. Residency needs: US primary, EU secondary for specific workloads.

Please send a simple matrix we can drop into our procurement template.

Cheers,
Sara
Sara Patel
Sr. Procurement Manager, Medica Health
procurement@medica-health.com

Attachments: procurement_template_v2.docx (we will reference this in your response)

From: evelyn_hart@redwood.com
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@medica-health.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit log / KMS / Residency pricing request

Sara — thanks for the clear asks. I've attached a quick pricing matrix that breaks list price vs two committed tiers and includes an example amortization of an implementation credit for HSM seats.

Key highlights from the attached:
- Audit log retention: list is $0.20/GB/month for 30d, $0.45/GB/month for 1yr, $0.80/GB/month for 3yr (discountable).
- Audit ingest: list $0.03/GB ingest; we can waive ingest fees for pilot for up to 10TB if you commit to a pilot MOU.
- KMS vs HSM: KMS (customer-managed keys) included; HSM seats are $4,500/seat/year list OR a per-request model at $0.0006/request.
- HIPAA bundle: typically list-priced at $15k/month for residency + HSM baseline + 90-day audit retention; discountable with commit.

Provisional discounts in the sheet: 12-mo commit = 15% off list for add-ons; 36-mo commit = 22% off list + one-time implementation credit amortized over 12 months (value depends on HSM seat count).

Next steps: if 36 months is likely, we can run a short econ model for the token ramp you provided and propose a blended effective per-token add-on. If you'd prefer a pilot-first path, we'll draft an MOU to waive ingest for the first 90 days (up to 10TB) in exchange for a defined pilot acceptance metric.

Attached: compliance_pricing_matrix_v1.xlsx

—Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Evelyn.Hart@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0193

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@medica-health.com>, evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit log / KMS / Residency pricing request

Sara — looping in as requested. A couple of practical notes from the sales side:

1) Discount posture: we can flex to 18% on add-ons for a 12-month committed revenue minimum of $120k (annualized). For a 36-month commit we can push to 20–25% depending on total committed spend and whether you take residency+HSM as a bundle.

2) HSM economics: because HSM seats are capacity-limited in some regions, we normally prefer a mixed model: reserve N seats (discounted) + per-request overflow billing. That keeps your baseline SLA tight while avoiding large upfront seat purchases. Example: reserve 2 seats @ $3,800/seat/year (post-discount) + overflow at $0.00045/request.

3) Audit log ingestion waiver: we can do the 90-day ingestion waiver for pilots, but only up to 10TB and contingent on a pilot MOU and a signed SOW for onboarding work (implementation hours are covered by the MOU credit).

If you can confirm the target committed spend (or a target per-month spend for year 1), we will run the blended model and circulate a one-page commercial summary.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachment: commercial_onepager_stub.pdf

From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@medica-health.com>

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit log / KMS / Residency pricing request

Thanks — team quick note from procurement & finance:

- Medica prefers a 12-month executed contract for procurement cycle reasons, but we are open to a 36-month economic commitment that starts after a 3-mo pilot.
- Would Redwood accept a blended concession: 18% off add-ons for 12 months (with a committed minimum of $150k ARR) + waived ingest fees for first 3 months of pilot? Finance would like the ingest waiver to be tied to a signed MOU (pilot acceptance criteria + go/no-go date).

If you can confirm those two points and push a commercial summary and MOU, I can expedite internal approvals.

Sara

Sara — appreciate the specificity. We can accept your blended concession: 18% off add-ons for 12 months with a committed minimum ARR of $150k, plus waived ingest fees for the first 90 days of the pilot (up to 10TB), conditional on:

1) Signed pilot MOU that includes acceptance criteria and go/no-go date;
2) A mutually agreed mutual action plan (MAP) and an SOW for onboarding (we will apply a $25k implementation credit amortized over 12 months in the invoice schedule);
3) Residency scope defined in the MAP (US primary, list of EU workloads in an appendix).

Next deliverables from our side (today):
- Updated one-page commercial summary (link below)
- Draft MOU for pilot (attached as mutual_action_plan.docx)
